statement: Price of inference at fixed capability falls >= 10x from 2026 to 2027 (Epoch / AI Index price series; 2027 annual)
status_at_phase_end: Historical trend sits just above threshold: Epoch's Sept 2026 study finds ~13x/yr cost decline at fixed performance since 2023 (75x/yr right after a level debuts, slowing to ~4.7x/yr two years on). Other methods give 5-10x/yr. Resolution depends heavily on which capability level is fixed; frontier list prices held or rose in 2026. Lean toward YES for a freshly-SOTA 2026 level, toward NO for older levels.

items.summary: Academic study (revised) finds frontier-model price for a given benchmark score falls ~5-10x per year, while the cost of running frontier models through benchmarks rose ~3-18x per year.
items.detail: Gundlach et al., arXiv paper revised 2026-03-23 (MIT researchers), as cited by Safeguard 2026-10-19 and The Decoder 2026-09-24.

items.summary: Annual AI index restates that GPT-3.5-level query cost fell >280-fold (Nov 2022-Oct 2024, ~$20 to ~$0.07 per million tokens), the standard fixed-capability reference series.
items.detail: Stanford AI Index 2026 (carry-forward of 2025 series), per secondary compilations.

items.summary: Market tracker reported average token price falling ~43% in ten weeks to ~$1.16-1.18 per million tokens after mid-2026 price cuts (not capability-adjusted).
items.detail: Crypto Briefing, early Aug 2026 (date approximate). Blended price, low methodological rigor.

items.summary: Epoch AI: across five benchmarks the cost of achieving a fixed performance level (counting all tokens, including reasoning) fell ~47% per quarter since 2023, i.e. ~13x per year; 75x/yr just after a level first becomes SOTA, ~4.7x/yr two years later. Example: cost to match a top early-2025 reasoning score on a science benchmark fell ~725x in under 18 months.
items.detail: Epoch AI, 'The plunging price of thought' (Emberson & Roodman). Benchmarks: AIME, chess puzzles, FrontierMath t1-3, GPQA Diamond, mystery puzzles (39-53%/quarter).

items.summary: A Bloc A developer scheduled list-price increases for two current models, and frontier list prices broadly held or rose in 2026, even as one developer cut its top tier from $15/$75 to $4/$20 per million tokens.
items.detail: Google Gemini 4 Argon and Gemini 3.8 Flash price increases (pricing page updated 2026-10-16); Anthropic Opus tier cut. Via Safeguard 2026-10-19.

items.summary: Industry analyst forecast: provider inference cost for a comparable ~1-trillion-parameter model will be >90% lower in 2030 than 2025 (well under 10x/yr), while cost per agentic workflow rises.
items.detail: Gartner forecast, March 2026 (exact date approximate), via AI Price Index tracker.
